# Parley v0.1.23

This test beta is the September 2026 reduction: eight removals agreed on
8 September to hold feature scope and cut breadth that did not hand work
between explicit panes or make that visibly safer. The application is
smaller by about six thousand lines of Swift and the VS Code extension is
gone. Behaviour that remains is unchanged, including the idle-polling
performance work measured on v0.1.22.

## Removed

- Smart orchestration: the Plan → Review → Implement → Verify state machine,
  its window, notices and Help. The five recipe templates, the recipe runner
  and the review-and-correct practice remain as guidance.
- The VS Code companion and its context bridge: the extension, the
  `.parleycontext` import, the published attention snapshot and the
  `parley://focus` and `parley://status` URLs. Native file and diff
  capture, Context Packs and `parley open` remain.
- Automatic idle-agent reaping and its switches. Explicit Stop remains.
- Workspace briefs and pinned snippets as separate stores and editors.
  Older context packs that carried them still open and display.
- Team templates and Clone Configuration. Roles, Move, saved layouts and
  team sessions remain; `parley team request` now refuses `--template` with
  a reason instead of folding it into the objective.

## Folded

- The menu-bar item list is now an attention indicator: the bell keeps its
  count and DEV marker, and its menu offers Open Parley, Open Status Center
  and Quit. Items are read in Status Center.
- The Task Manager window is now the Processes group in Status Center's
  Health section, sampling only while that section is visible.
- Focus Canvas and Pane Grid are now Zoom and Unzoom, with the same
  enlargement of one pane and the same Command-Shift-F. The global Unzoom
  always clears whichever pane is zoomed.

## Agent protocol

- The canonical text changed in several rows, so the protocol version is
  now 28. Live agent panes show RESTART FOR PROTOCOL once after installing
  this build.

## Retired files

- Any `supervised-workflows.json`, `team-templates.json`,
  `workspace-briefs.json` or `pinned-context-snippets.json` under the
  application's support directory is left in place and no longer read.

Unnotarized test beta: ad-hoc signed without the hardened runtime, not
notarized, no automatic updates. Install only from the expected GitLab
release after checking SHA256SUMS.
